title: Wren and the Witness
author: Ulyana Dunmore
blurb: Kestrel Iversen, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
